scenario_or_breakage: `log-phase.sh` calls `larch-log.sh write`, which resolves mode via `larch_log_batch_mode "$BATCH"` and fails with `unknown batch` for slugs absent from `LARCH_LOG_BATCHES`
suggested_fix: Register the slug in `scripts/larch-log-batches.sh` (extension `.tsv`, `replace`, sanitizer `none` like `review-tally`), extend `scripts/test-larch-logs-batches.sh` expected slug list, and update `scripts/larch-log-batches.md` in the same change set per repo contract

what: Fixture C requires per-finding classification rows when `EFFECTIVE_VOTERS==0`, but the plan places classification work only inside the post-check `for block in …` loop
scenario_or_breakage: Current early-exit path exits before any per-block iteration, so no per-`finding_id` rows can be produced without additional structure
suggested_fix: Spell out an explicit branch: either iterate `block_files` once before `exit 0` to emit `findings-classification.tsv` rows with empty voter columns, or revise Fixture C to only assert a header file and align tally markdown expectations

what: Edge-case text claims rating tokens can appear in arbitrary order while `vote_for_id` only recognizes `YES|NO|EXONERATE` as the first token after `<ID>:`
scenario_or_breakage: Judges or tests that reorder tokens get `JUDGE_ERROR` for tally and can trip parse-rate logic despite a lenient L2 axis parser
suggested_fix: Clarify in the plan and voter prompt that the vote token must remain immediately after `<ID>:`; reserve position-agnostic wording for the rating-key parser only

what: Parse-rate `ids_count` and per-id checks only consider `### FINDING_[0-9]+:` headings, not `### OOS_[0-9]+:`
scenario_or_breakage: OOS-heavy ballots under-count required structured lines so a voter missing all `OOS_N:` votes can still look parse-healthy, or pure-OOS ballots skip structured-output validation entirely
suggested_fix: Extend parse-rate counting and the per-id probe list to include `OOS_` headings when present, or document the deliberate omission and add a harness case if behavior stays

what: Plan updates Step 4 logging but not the KV contracts for Step 3 / heavy-worker handoff
scenario_or_breakage: Parent wrappers and `--subagent` runs that bind `YIELD_TSV_FILE` but ignore the new KV will omit classification paths from orchestration and footers even when present
suggested_fix: Add `FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION_TSV_FILE` to Step 3’s parsed KV list in `skills/review/SKILL.md`, mirror it in `heavy-worker.md`, and extend any subagent footer template that currently forwards scout KVs

what: Raw axis tokens (including rationale-adjacent text) are copied into a TSV without an escaping contract
scenario_or_breakage: A judge output containing literal tabs or newlines inside a token breaks column alignment or merges rows for downstream TSV consumers
suggested_fix: Define escaping (e.g. strip/replace tabs and newlines in field values, or JSON-wrap the row) in tally before writing `findings-classification.tsv`

what: Nested flows that read `YIELD_TSV_FILE` from `review-core` output may need the new KV for parity
scenario_or_breakage: Implement-only consumers of tally stdout could drop classification paths when wiring logs or summaries
suggested_fix: Track whether `review-and-fix.sh` (or similar) should surface `FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION_TSV_FILE` alongside `YIELD_TSV_FILE` after this feature lands
